newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egyptian match profits down in 95/96.
newsitem.headline: Egyptian match profits down in 95/96.

text.p: Privatised Egyptian Nile Match and Prefabricated Houses net after-tax profits fell slightly to 8.117 million pounds in the 1995/96 financial year from 8.929 million in 1994/5, according to unaudited results available on Monday. The year end on June 30.
Profits before tax were also lower at 11.217 million against 12.169 million.
But turnover rose to 93.904 million pounds from 91.001 million in the previous year, the results showed.
Shareholders' equity at the end of 1995/96 was also down at 37.289 million pounds from 37.812 million at the end of the previous year.
The state sold about 65 percent of Nile Match's two million shares to private investors in August at 27 pound a share. The stock closed on Sunday at 28.80 pounds.
